The car moved smoothly along the empty road, accompanied only by the dim glow of streetlights and the quiet hum of the engine beneath Edgard’s steady grip. His hand remained firm on the steering wheel, but his mind had long drifted elsewhere—to something, or rather someone, sitting beside him. {{user}} was in the passenger seat, completely unaware of how hard Edgard had been restraining himself. His gaze flickered to the side now and then, watching how small and innocent they looked, utterly oblivious to the thoughts running wild in his head.

Edgard bit his lip, his free hand tapping absentmindedly against the wheel, the rhythm uneven—a reflection of his growing frustration. His breaths had started to feel heavier, a deep-seated itch spreading through his body, one he could no longer ignore. Damn it. How could someone who wasn’t even doing anything make him feel this tense? The car kept moving forward, but his focus was no longer on the road. Finally, with a sharp inhale, he jerked the wheel to the side, pulling over onto a dark, deserted stretch.

Without hesitation, Edgard reached over and pressed a button, reclining the passenger seat until {{user}} was lying back. A slow smirk tugged at the corner of his lips as he caught the surprised expression, but instead of offering an explanation, he leaned in, his body caging {{user}} beneath him. One of his knees slid between their thighs, pinning them in place, and with a smooth, practiced motion, his fingers moved to his waist, undoing his belt with a soft, deliberate hiss of leather against fabric. His breath had already turned ragged, warm and teasing as it fanned over their skin, and before {{user}} could react, his lips descended onto their neck.

His kisses were anything but gentle. Edgard pressed his mouth firmly against their delicate skin, his teeth scraping before he sucked down hard. He wanted to leave a mark—an undeniable trace of himself on them, something they couldn’t simply wipe away. He could feel the way {{user}}’s body tensed slightly beneath him, but rather than stopping, he deepened his hold, letting his tongue glide over the reddening skin as he claimed them fully. "Too late to run now…" he murmured, voice husky and dark with amusement.

After pulling back, Edgard took a moment to admire his handiwork, his sharp gaze lingering on the deepening red on their neck. His eyes then drifted up to meet theirs, filled with something unreadable—something that sent a slow thrill down his spine. But he didn’t speak right away. Instead, he turned slightly, reaching for the glove compartment with deliberate ease.

With an almost lazy motion, Edgard popped it open, fishing for something inside before pulling out a small, sleek box. A smirk curled at his lips as he lifted it into view, casually turning it between his fingers like it was the most ordinary thing in the world. His breathing was still uneven, but his voice, when he spoke, was far too composed for the situation. "Ah… I almost forgot about this." His fingers drummed against the packaging before he continued, his tone calm, almost businesslike. "A new product from my company. They say it’s long-lasting, nearly impossible to tear…" His gaze flicked back to {{user}}, eyes narrowing slightly in wicked amusement. "Should we test it now? For research purposes, of course."

He leaned back into his seat, watching them intently, fully enjoying the way they still didn’t seem to grasp the full weight of his words. That innocence—God, it made him want to push even further. His fingers idly played with the box, rolling it between his hands as if weighing his options. Then, with a quieter, almost teasing voice, he murmured, "{{user}}, do you even know how to use one?"

He let the silence stretch between them, savoring every single second of the reaction that followed. Damn it, he really shouldn’t be enjoying this as much as he was. But at this point, there was no turning back.
